resources.string: Login expired, please log in again

When using the account and password login, credentials are encrypted on-device via AES-CBC and sent directly to the school CAS unified authentication server. Encryption uses a dynamic salt issued by the official server, unique for each request. This app never sends your account or password to any third-party server.

When using QR code login, an independent cookie environment is used. You can save the QR code locally and scan it with an already logged-in device, or use the \"Open in other app\" feature to share the link to a logged-in environment for authentication.
When using multi-account login, each user session is stored independently and does not interfere with others. You can clear local login data at any time from the account manager.

Exporting login credentials requires device password verification. Exported data is AES-encrypted with custom password protection, and importing requires the same decryption password, ensuring safe credential migration between devices.

The password recovery feature opens the school\'s official recovery page. Due to browser sandbox properties, this app does not capture any recovery information (including verification codes or passwords).

After successful login, the password and cookies are stored locally on the device for proper functionality. Cookies are persisted via the Android system WebKit CookieManager, accessible only by this process. For the remember password feature, the password is encrypted and stored in the device private storage, inaccessible to other apps. This app does not collect or transmit any local login information to third parties.
Please download this app from official open-source repositories or other trusted channels.
